chunks: Abdul Wahid ibn Muhammad ibn Abdus al-Naysaburi al-Attar (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Qutayba al-Naysaburi narrated to me, from Hamdan ibn Sulayman, from Abdul Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:

May God have mercy upon a servant who revives our affairs.' I said to him, 'How can one revive your affairs?' He said, 'He learns our knowledge and teaches it to the people, for if the people knew the merits of our speech, they would follow us.'

I said, 'O son of the Messenger of God! A tradition has been narrated to us from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said: Whoever learns knowledge to argue with the ignorant, or to be haughty with the scholars, or to attract the faces of the people to himself, he is in the Fire.'

He (peace be upon him) said, 'My grandfather (peace be upon him) spoke the truth. Do you know who the ignorant ones are?' I said, 'No, O son of the Messenger of God.' He said, 'They are the storytellers of our opponents.' And do you know who the scholars are?' I said, 'No, O son of the Messenger of God.' He said, 'They are the scholars of the Household of Muhammad (peace be upon him) whose obedience God has made incumbent and their love He has made obligatory.'

Then he said, 'And do you know the meaning of his saying: or to attract the faces of the people to himself?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'He means, by God, an undue claim to the Imamate, and whoever does that, he is in the Fire.'

key_terms.عُلَمَاءُ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The scholars of the Household of Muhammad

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Rida define the correct way to revive the affairs of the Imams and clarify the meaning of learning knowledge for the ignorant and scholars?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (s) clarifies that reviving the Ahl al-Bayt's legacy requires authentic transmission of their knowledge, noting that public adherence stems from recognizing the eloquence and merit of their speech. He contextualizes a warning from Imam al-Sadiq (s) by distinguishing between superficial 'ignorant' storytellers and the authoritative 'scholars' of the Household, whose obedience is divinely mandated. Furthermore, he interprets 'attracting faces' as the specific sin of false claimants to the Imamate, linking scholarly authority directly to legitimate spiritual leadership.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-64 Abdul Wahid Muhammad ibn Ubdoos al-Neishaboori al-Attar - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutayba al-Neishaboori quoted on the authority of Hamdan ibn Soleiman al-Neishaboori, on the authority of Abdul Salam ibn Salih al-Harawi that he had heard Abul Hassan Ali ibn Musa Al-Ridha (s) say,

“May God have Mercy upon anyone who revives our affairs.’ Al-Harawi asked the Imam (s), “How can one revive your affairs?” The Imam (s) said, “He can learn our knowledge and teach it to the people. If the people get informed of those good teachings, they would follow us.’”

The narrator (Salih al-Harawi) added, “I said, O son of the Prophet of God! A tradition has been narrated on the authority of Abi Abdullah (s)which says, ‘Whoever learns things in order to argue with the ignorant ones or be haughty with the scholars, and attracts some of the people to himself, will go into the Fire.’”

The Imam (s) said, “My grandfather (s) spoke the truth. Do you know who the ignorant ones are?” I said, “O son of the Prophet of God! No.” The Imam (s) said, “They are our opponents who make up stories. Do you know who the scholars are?” I said, “O son of the Prophet of God! No.” The Imam (s) said, “They are the scholars from the Household of Muhammad (s) whose obedience to the Honorable the Exalted God has made incumbent (upon the people) and God has made it obligatory upon the people to love them.”

The Imam (s) then added, “Do you know what Abi Abdullah (s) meant when he (s) said, ‘…attract some of the people to himself?’” I said, “No.” The Imam (s) said, “I swear by God that this means an undue claim to be a Divine Leader. Whoever does so will go to Hell.”
